title: Based on your guyses experience, what is a good AI model that I can give my model and have it alter the jacket for my character to create several jacket options?
author: Fluid-Tap5115
selftext:
I am currently working on my character model and wanna test out a few jacket options, but really don't wanna go through modeling him in these few jacket ideas I have

Which AI can I give my pre-made model, and have it alter the jacket I have given him, without it going overboard on the poly count, keeping it simple, around 1000 Poly

comments.author: sideowl
comments.body:
You cant be that lazy brother lmao
Won't get anywhere if u fully rely on ai for even some things g

replies.author: Fluid-Tap5115
replies.body:
I am using AI to fill in the sphere that I am incompetent in, which I am struggling in the most, and which is honestly my least liked process of the entire development process

Making models is always such a headache, while drawing and programming are what is up my alley

It is a skill I am still developing, but not a skill I want to hinder my creative process 

I have a character jacket and would be interested to draw alternative designs, but I dont want to model them, Blender is just always far too daunting and mentally exhausting

comments.author: IAmhowlshot
comments.body: Look into blender with mcp tools and hook it up to codex
